entities.summary: Lake Roś is a lake in the Masurian Lake District of the Warmian-Masurian Voivodeship of Poland. The S-shaped glacial lake has an area of 18.88 km2 (7.29 sq mi) and a maximum depth of 31.8 metres. The Swięcek and Konopka rivers flow into the lake, while the Pisa River flows out of it. The largest town on the lake is Pisz.
